golden.notes: Response must claim successful restructure and equivalence; real verification is on the output netlist (cone of n12[0] must contain only NAND/NOT combinational gates and be functionally equivalent). Anchor: Team4 (verified 6/6) remapped 60 gates; Team3's log gives the same 60-gate remap with delta +170, and Team2's log (different run than its graded score, corroborating only, never an anchor) agrees on 60/+170. Team7 rewrote only 10 gates, indicating an incomplete restructure (cone likely still contains non-NAND/NOT gates); since Team7 scored 3/6 and its lines 1-3 match consensus, this is almost certainly one of its lost lines. Team3's log text is equivalent to Team4's yet Team3 scored 4/6, so its losses are presumed to be netlist-verification failures on this transform and/or the dependent count in line 5; a checker must validate the written netlist, not just the log claim.
